response.sql: WITH manager_award_counts AS (SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) as count FROM manager_award GROUP BY player_id), total_awards AS (SELECT SUM(count) as total FROM manager_award_counts) SELECT mdc.player_id, mdc.count, mdc.count::NUMERIC / t.total as fraction FROM manager_award_counts mdc CROSS JOIN total_awards t WHERE t.total IS NOT NULL ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10;
